title: FBI-UAP-D037, FD-302, “Multiple Red Lights,” 2026
doc_notes: This is an FBI FD-302 interview report documenting a civilian's account of unidentified aerial phenomena; the document contains encounter content.

encounters.summary: Two individuals observed multiple unidentified lights exhibiting non-linear movement, low-altitude hovering, and a localized glow in a dry wash, accompanied by a reported mechanical watch time discrepancy.
encounters.entity_behavior: moved erratically, hovered at low altitude, emitted glow
encounters.quote: the lights he observed and described were unlike anything he had seen before
